Ivy: Tiny flavor thread20

Ivy: Game: pick one song (<=4min) + one short visual (single TV ep, short film, or music video) that fit the same movie-scene vibe. Say the scene tag (e.g., "late-night diner", "closing montage"). I'll start.
Ivy: Song  'Goldfrapp - Ooh La La' (3:44)  Scene tag: "neon-diner, goofy swagger". Visual  'Brokeback Mountain' clip? Too long. OK the music video 'Run Lola Run' opening sequence (shorter edit)  same energy. :neon:
Noah: Love it. Mine:
Noah: Song  'Warpaint - Love Is to Die' (3:50). Scene: "rainy street goodbye". Visual  short film 'The Black Hole' (2008)  moody, perfect for that beat.
Sam: Going cinematic but tiny:
Sam: Song  'Massive Attack - Teardrop' (3:44 edit). Scene: "early-morning subway revelation". Visual  'World of Tomorrow' (17min)  gets the surreal kick.
Becky: For a ridiculous upbeat flip:
Becky: Song  'The Strokes - Last Nite' (3:13). Scene: "parking-lot epiphany". Visual  'Scott Pilgrim vs. The World' music video short (clip)  instant nostalgia. :sunglasses:
Jules: Quick meme + logistics: Cole dropped a GIF of a cat dramatically sippin coffee in the #random thread, 100% approved. Also projector booked Fri 4pm for the "scene-pairing" hour.
deploy-bot: Reminder: please don't stream anything using production infra. Use the lounge network for Friday screenings.
Ivy: Poll: react with :one: if your pick is "noir/atmospheric", :two: for "uplift/nostalgia", :three: for "surreal/experimental". I'll tally in an hour.
Noah: Also, playlist idea: I'll drop everyone's songs into a 10-track "scene-pairing" playlist and add short notes in the description. Want collaborative edits?
Sam: Yes please. Also can someone mirror short films to /team/media/shorts/ for offline playback? Vimeo gets flaky on guest wifi.
Becky: I can mirror public-domain stuff. If you want proprietary clips, bring them on a USB and label format.
Ivy: Tally halfway: :one: 4 :two: 2 :three: 1  noir/atmospheric leading. Cute cat GIF winner so far.
Jules: Sign-up for 2-min intros during the hour: https://tiny.signup/scene-pairings (placeholder). I'll bring cookies. :cookie:
